name: Golden Time: Vivid Memories
original_name: ゴールデンタイム Vivid Memories
source:
Adapted from Takemiya Yuyuko's light novel "Golden Time". The series follows Tada Banri who lost his memories and his spirit has awoken as a separate entity. In this game, You get to choose how Tada spends his days and perhaps who he falls in love with. Golden Time: Vivid Memories has over 20 endings.

[Edited from [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2013/10/18/first-look-golden-time-vivid-memories-koko-kaga-figurine//]Siliconera[/url]]

A limited edition priced at 10,479 yen ($106) includes the game plus a fan book and 1/8 figurine of Koko Kaga in a swimsuit. The game alone costs 6,279 yen ($65).

[From [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2013/10/06/golden-time-vivid-memories-puts-shoes-guy-without-memories/]Siliconera[/url]]
